# Pega to Announce Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2026 and Host Conference Call and Webcast


**WALTHAM, Mass. – October 7, 2026 –**[Pegasystems Inc.](https://www.pega.com/) (NASDAQ: PEGA), the enterprise AI software company for mission-critical work, today announced it will report financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, after market close.


A conference call and audio-only webcast will be conducted at 8:00 a.m. EDT on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. Members of the public and investors are invited to join the call and participate in the question and answer session by dialing 1 (833) 461-5787 (domestic) or 1 (626) 884-3620 (international) and using Conference ID 591038520, visiting[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/591038520](https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/591038520) , or by logging onto[www.pega.com](https://www.pega.com/) at least five minutes prior to the event's broadcast and clicking on the[webcast](https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/591038520) icon in the[Investors](https://www.pega.com/investors) section.


A replay of the call will also be available on[www.pega.com](https://www.pega.com/) by clicking the Q3/FY’26 Earnings Call link in the[Investors](https://www.pega.com/investors) section.
